# Emp

EMP balance changes. Shuttle consoles and APCs ignore EMP pulses entirely: no power cut, no battery drain and no
breaker lockout, so an EMP can't take a ship's helm or power offline. `EmpImmunitySystem` cancels the
`EmpAttemptEvent` on them; `EmpImmunityTest` covers it.
